title: "Independent eQTL and DEG overlap summary"
output: html_notebook

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(here)
})

here::i_am("code/11_eQTL_coloc/example_scripts/04_eqtl_explore.Rmd")

repo_root <- here()
tqtl_in_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_in")
tqtl_out_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_out")
summary_dir <- file.path(tqtl_out_dir, "summary")
dir.create(summary_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-manifest-and-degs}
manifest_file <- file.path(tqtl_in_dir, "prep_manifest.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(manifest_file))

manifest <- fread(manifest_file)
manifest <- manifest[status == "prepared", .(dataset_id, context = seurat_label, split)]
manifest[, split := fifelse(split == "male", "male",
                     fifelse(split == "female", "female", "all"))]

deg_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source(here("code", "11_eQTL_coloc", "03_load_DEG_results.R"), local = deg_env, chdir = FALSE)

context_order <- names(deg_env$SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID)
split_order <- c("all", "male", "female")

stopifnot(length(unique(manifest$dataset_id)) == nrow(manifest))
stopifnot(all(manifest$dataset_id %in% names(deg_env$deg_by_dataset_id)))

manifest <- manifest[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
manifest
```

```{r helpers}
required_indep_cols <- c("phenotype_id", "variant_id", "rank")

read_map_independent <- function(dataset_id) {
  rel_path <- file.path("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "tqtl_out",
                        paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.map_independent.txt.gz"))
  abs_path <- file.path(repo_root, rel_path)

  if (!file.exists(abs_path)) {
    return(list(
      status = "missing_map_independent",
      rel_path = NA_character_,
      dt = NULL
    ))
  }

  dt <- fread(abs_path)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_indep_cols, names(dt))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ", rel_path, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  list(
    status = "ok",
    rel_path = rel_path,
    dt = dt
  )
}

collapse_egenes <- function(dt) {
  unique(dt[, .(gene_id = phenotype_id)])
}

collapse_gene_list <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]))
  if (length(x) == 0) "" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
}

summarize_dataset_counts <- function(dataset_id, context, split, file_info) {
  if (identical(file_info$status, "missing_map_independent")) {
    return(data.table(
      dataset_id = dataset_id,
      context = context,
      split = split,
      status = file_info$status,
      map_independent_file = NA_character_,
      n_independent_signals = NA_integer_,
      n_eGenes = NA_integer_,
      max_rank = NA_integer_,
      lead_variant_count = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  dt <- file_info$dt
  data.table(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    context = context,
    split = split,
    status = file_info$status,
    map_independent_file = file_info$rel_path,
    n_independent_signals = nrow(dt),
    n_eGenes = uniqueN(dt$phenotype_id),
    max_rank = as.integer(max(dt$rank, na.rm = TRUE)),
    lead_variant_count = uniqueN(dt$variant_id)
  )
}

summarize_dataset_overlap <- function(dataset_id, context, split, file_info, deg_dt) {
  n_context_degs <- nrow(deg_dt)

  if (identical(file_info$status, "missing_map_independent")) {
    return(data.table(
      dataset_id = dataset_id,
      context = context,
      split = split,
      status = file_info$status,
      map_independent_file = NA_character_,
      n_independent_signals = NA_integer_,
      n_eGenes = NA_integer_,
      n_context_DEGs = n_context_degs,
      n_eGene_DEG_overlap = NA_integer_,
      eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids = NA_character_,
      eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  dt <- file_info$dt
  egenes <- collapse_egenes(dt)
  overlap_dt <- merge(
    egenes,
    as.data.table(deg_dt),
    by = "gene_id",
    all = FALSE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  data.table(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    context = context,
    split = split,
    status = file_info$status,
    map_independent_file = file_info$rel_path,
    n_independent_signals = nrow(dt),
    n_eGenes = nrow(egenes),
    n_context_DEGs = n_context_degs,
    n_eGene_DEG_overlap = uniqueN(overlap_dt$gene_id),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_ids = collapse_gene_list(overlap_dt$gene_id),
    eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names = collapse_gene_list(overlap_dt$gene_name)
  )
}
```

```{r summarize-map-independent}
summary_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
  row <- manifest[i]
  dataset_id <- row$dataset_id[[1]]
  context <- row$context[[1]]
  split <- row$split[[1]]

  file_info <- read_map_independent(dataset_id)
  deg_dt <- as.data.table(deg_env$deg_by_dataset_id[[dataset_id]])

  list(
    counts = summarize_dataset_counts(dataset_id, context, split, file_info),
    overlap = summarize_dataset_overlap(dataset_id, context, split, file_info, deg_dt)
  )
})

counts_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "counts"), use.names = TRUE)
overlap_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(summary_rows, `[[`, "overlap"), use.names = TRUE)

counts_dt <- counts_dt[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]
overlap_dt <- overlap_dt[order(match(split, split_order), match(context, context_order))]

counts_dt
overlap_dt
```

```{r write-csvs}
split_to_suffix <- c(all = "all", male = "male", female = "female")

counts_tables <- lapply(names(split_to_suffix), function(split_name) {
  counts_dt[split == split_name]
})
names(counts_tables) <- names(split_to_suffix)

overlap_tables <- lapply(names(split_to_suffix), function(split_name) {
  overlap_dt[split == split_name]
})
names(overlap_tables) <- names(split_to_suffix)

for (split_name in names(split_to_suffix)) {
  suffix <- split_to_suffix[[split_name]]

  fwrite(
    counts_tables[[split_name]],
    file.path(summary_dir, paste0("map_independent_counts_", suffix, ".csv"))
  )
  fwrite(
    overlap_tables[[split_name]],
    file.path(summary_dir, paste0("map_independent_deg_overlap_", suffix, ".csv"))
  )
}

list.files(summary_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = FALSE)
```
